_comment: Test process batch plan (.agent/skills/13-test-process.md). One batch = one working session, at most 5 modules. Every module appears exactly once. Order = risk × value; modules in a batch share helpers. Progress is derived from the repo: run `yarn test:progress`.

batches.title: Pure logic and the data foundation
batches.why: Pure functions and the HTTP/data layer: highest value per test, no UI, everything else builds on them. Money and error mapping are T0.
batches.focus: Complete platform/data-layer (list-query, media-url, product-url, SWR hooks, store) and platform/dev-tooling (check-conventions, check-docs, i18n scripts) which are only partly covered. Table-driven unit tests; hooks via renderHook + MSW.

batches.title: Cart, checkout and the customer's orders
batches.why: Money and stock: a bug here loses revenue. All are private pages, so every module has the guest-versus-signed-in dimension.
batches.focus: Extend renderApp with the Redux store (fresh state per test) and next/navigation (useSearchParams, useParams). Cart reducer and sync, optimistic updates, checkout totals from the BE, payment session.

batches.title: Shared admin kit and the money-moving admin pages
batches.why: DataTable and the form kit are used by every admin page; testing them once covers a lot. Orders and payments change order and payment state.
batches.focus: First batch with the permission dimension: admin đủ quyền versus admin thiếu quyền (adminLimited) on every action button. DataTable server mode (search, sort, pagination, error), form validation.

batches.title: Admin: refunds, returns, reviews, users, categories
batches.why: After-sales and access management. Users controls who gets which permission.
batches.focus: Permission matrix per action (view, process, moderate, reply, refund). Reuse the DataTable and form helpers from batch 3.

batches.title: Admin: the rest
batches.why: Lower risk configuration and reporting pages that follow the same patterns.
batches.focus: Media upload (success, failure, no storage configured), site-config upsert/delete, dashboard and analytics data states (loading, empty, error).

batches.title: Storefront: browse and buy
batches.why: The public path that leads to revenue: landing, shop, product detail, collections, new in.
batches.focus: Guest and signed-in behaviour of add-to-cart and wishlist (requireAuth), filters and sorting in the URL, out-of-stock and not-found states, structured data.

batches.title: Storefront: account, reviews and content pages
batches.why: Remaining customer pages. Reviews and account are private; the rest are static content.
batches.focus: Review create/edit/delete with images (success, validation, failure), account profile, contact form submit and errors, static pages as smoke plus metadata.

batches.title: App frame and presentation
batches.why: Mostly presentational shell: header, menus, footer, providers, tokens. Smoke and accessibility, not deep logic.
batches.focus: Header/menu for guest and signed-in, search bar, language switcher, route transition, 404/error pages; design tokens are declared N/A with a reason where there is nothing to test.
